lines.text: Work judged by eye or ear (a render, an image, an animation, a sound) starts with /perceptual-loop:perceptual-loop and its doctrine, before the first change.
A metric that moved is not a verdict: open the picture yourself and classify the difference (wrong, less-plausible, more-correct, different-ok, noise, stale).
Defects are yours to fix; taste (how bright, how much, which of two plausible looks) is the owner's to decide.

Render the smallest run that answers the question: the 1 to 3 proving shots per iteration, the whole suite once, when the work is finished. The gate compares a candidate with its own accepted run; never set a target against the reference.

chains.text: An owed full run or a stale baseline becomes a gate card (`aw board owe`), and a render only one session may run at a time goes under /agent-works:resource-locks.
A ruling with reach (how every sky should look) becomes a decision record through /but-first-planning:spec-edit.
